meta: Concept site for Wrenfield Family Dentistry, a made-up Raleigh, North Carolina family dentist: cleanings, fillings, crowns, whitening and calm first visits. Designed by shash.builds.

hero.eyebrow: Family dentistry in Raleigh, North Carolina
hero.title: Calm, unhurried dental care for the whole family.
hero.sub: Cleanings, fillings, crowns and whitening in North Raleigh, with early mornings and Saturdays for busy families. Nervous? Tell us, and we'll go at your pace.

extra.title: What happens when you come in.
items: Ten minutes to talk about your teeth, your worries and your budget before anything else.
A gentle exam, low-dose digital X-rays and photos you can see on the screen with us.
What needs doing now, what can wait, and the price of each, in writing.

services_title: Everything a family needs, in one office.
services: Every six months for adults and kids, with a gentle hygienist who explains as they go.
Tooth-colored fillings that match, usually done in one visit.
Strong, natural-looking restorations for cracked or worn teeth.
In-office or take-home trays, with honest advice on what to expect.
First visits from age one, with a slow, friendly pace and no lectures.
Same-day appointments for toothaches, chips and lost fillings.
steps: Book online or call. Early mornings and Saturdays fill fastest.
We text you a short form so you're not doing paperwork in the waiting room.
Headphones, a blanket and a dentist who explains before doing anything.

area.title: Close to home in North Raleigh.
area.note: Families come to us from across Wake County. Free parking right outside the door.

about.title: Dentistry without the rush.
body: Plenty of people put off the dentist because the last visit felt rushed, painful or full of surprises on the bill.
We book longer appointments, explain every step before we take it, and give you the price in writing before any treatment. You can always say stop.

promise.title: No surprise bills. Ever.
promise.body: You see the price of every treatment, and what your insurance should cover, before we start. If something changes mid-visit, we stop and ask.

faq: We accept most PPO plans and file the claim for you. Call or send the form with your plan name and we'll check before your visit.
I'm nervous about the dentist. Can you help?
Yes. Tell us when you book. We go slower, explain everything first and agree on a hand signal so you can stop anytime.
How old should my child be for a first visit?
Around their first birthday, or when the first tooth shows up. Early visits are short and mostly about getting comfortable.
Yes. Call first thing and we'll fit you in the same day for toothaches, chips or a lost filling or crown.
What if I don't have insurance?
You get the full price list up front, and we can spread larger treatments over a few visits.

form.title: Request an appointment.
form.note: Tell us what you need and when works best. We'll call or text to confirm a time.
